overview: The Planning and Permitting Committee reviewed proposed technical cleanups to the city zoning ordinance and refined draft language for a vacant building ordinance. The committee kept the zoning cleanups in committee for further staff revision and voted to refer the vacant building ordinance to the full City Council pending legal review.

items.title: Technical and Procedural Zoning Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: The committee reviewed proposed formatting fixes, typo corrections, and updated definitions for the zoning code with planning and building staff. The item was kept in committee to allow staff to compile a consolidated draft for review at an April meeting.

items.title: Vacant Building Ordinance
items.summary: The committee reviewed redlined updates to the proposed vacant building ordinance, discussing local property management definitions, square-footage-based registration fees, legal dispute waivers, and staff enforcement discretion. The committee voted to refer the paper out of committee to a regular City Council meeting pending finalized edits and legal review by KP Law.
